name: muapi-cartoon-dance-animation
tagline_zh: 上传一张普通照片，秒变皮克斯3D小人，再跟着参考视频跳起魔性舞蹈。连手指动作都自然，发朋友圈没人信是AI。
tagline_en: Turn a plain photo into a Pixar-style 3D character that dances to any reference video—even finger moves look.
desc_en: Convert a photo of a person into a Pixar-style 3D cartoon character, then animate it using a reference dance or motion video.
why_zh: 同类工具只换脸或动嘴，它连肢体节奏和手指细节都同步，舞蹈不僵硬，像真人在跳。
why_en: Unlike tools that just swap faces, it syncs full-body rhythm and finger details, making the dance fluid and human-like.
